events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with cat-themed installations, games and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise through claw-machine and scratch-off games.
events.caveats: Official Mars and TEMPTATIONS sources describe the physical pop-up as free and say visitors can stop by; no advance RSVP requirement is published. Giveaways are subject to availability/game mechanics.

events.event_name: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen Mobile Pop-Up
events.brand: Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen
events.address: Lexington Avenue; 557 Broadway; 21–27 9th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A mobile beauty-and-ice-cream activation celebrating Jung Saem Mool Beauty's Sephora launch, moving from Lexington Avenue to SoHo and Meatpacking each day.
events.what_is_free: Guests can receive a special Jung Saem Mool Beauty × Van Leeuwen ice cream by following @jsmbeauty_global. A separate social-post mechanic offers a chance at a full-size Metal Lip Serum, limited to 200 units per day.
events.caveats: The brand announcement verifies the Sept. 19–20 collaboration and overall daily windows; the stop-by-stop schedule is corroborated by the current event listing. Free ice cream requires following @jsmbeauty_global. Product giveaway has a separate social-post requirement and daily quantity limit.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 19 stops: 11 AM–1 PM Lexington Avenue; 1:30–3:30 PM at 557 Broadway; 4–7 PM at 21–27 9th Avenue. Sept. 20 uses the same first two windows and a 4–6 PM Meatpacking stop.

events.event_name: Printemps New York Fall/Winter 2026 Fashion Show
events.address: Printemps New York, 1 Wall Street, New York, NY 10005
events.what_it_is: A Fall/Winter 2026 runway presentation in Printemps New York's Red Room, followed by an opportunity to shop featured looks.
events.what_is_free: The official booking page lists the one-hour fashion show at $0.
events.caveats: The official Printemps page lists the event at $0 and provides a booking/add-to-cart flow. No organizer-selection or approval step is stated. Availability can change as the event approaches.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 5–6 PM in the Red Room at Printemps New York. Use the official Printemps event page to reserve the free one-hour slot.

events.what_it_is: A two-day reopening celebration for Credo Beauty's SoHo boutique with complimentary gifts, product raffles and an event-exclusive gift-with-purchase offer.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; no-purchase product raffles are also advertised. A separate gift-with-purchase requires a $100+ in-store purchase.
events.caveats: Current listings explicitly state RSVP is not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility. Complimentary gifts are first-come, first-served, limited to the first 150 guests each day and while supplies last. This record relies on current event listings rather than a separately indexed first-party event page.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19: 11 AM–7 PM. Sunday Sept. 20: 11 AM–6 PM. RSVP is optional; arriving early matters for the first-150 gift.
